n: Luanti Classroom mod and docs (luanti edu)
t: A teacher guide and classroom mod for using the Luanti block-world game with students.
steps: Find the Luanti edu guide and read it first. Some detailed guides are marked as unavailable.
Ask IT to approve and install Luanti on student devices.
Choose a school network server or a hosted service.
Add mods from ContentDB, including the Classroom mod.
Set world rules such as turning off fire and lava.
Give students basic privileges and keep teacher privileges private.
Test a short session with a small group.
Chromebook support was not confirmed. Test one device first.
